general.title: Anthropic-Backed Startup Led by Ex-Hg Executives Pushes Europe to Build AI Edge
general.summary: An Anthropic PBC-backed artificial intelligence consultancy started earlier this month by three former executives of private equity firm Hg is looking to hire “Europe’s elite AI talent” as it seeks to push the continent to catch up on the technology.

general.title: New Trump Tariffs Won’t Top Trade Deal Levels, Will Be Targeted
general.summary: President Donald Trump’s next round of tariffs won’t surpass levels set in US trade deals he’s negotiated and will be targeted for each economy rather than imposed as a blanket rate, according to people familiar with an announcement coming as soon as Tuesday.

general.title: Kalshi Users Under 21 Lost $8.9 Million in NYC, Probe Finds
general.summary: Over 50,000 people between the ages of 18 and 21 are using Kalshi in New York City, and they are losing money at a disproportionate rate, according to internal data that Kalshi released to the New York City Council.

general.title: Retailers Post Strong Earnings Ahead of Holidays
general.summary: Dick’s Sporting Goods raised its forecast as its Foot Locker chain returned to growth amid robust back-to-school shopping. Best Buy also raised sales and earnings forecasts for the year after reporting better-than-expected quarterly earnings on resilient demand for computing. Emily Cohn reports on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: US Consumer Confidence Surges to Highest Since Early 2025
general.summary: US consumer confidence surged in November to the highest in nearly two years as Americans grew more optimistic about the economy and the job market.

general.title: Venezuela Puts Debt at $237 Billion Ahead of Historic Overhaul
general.summary: Venezuela’s government said public debt stood at $237.5 billion in 2025, giving investors the first snapshot into its finances in years and setting the stage for what could be one of the largest sovereign debt restructurings in history. Bonds jumped.
